stem.en:
Some people think that every secondary school should teach its students how to cook simple, healthy meals.

Do you agree or disagree?

Support your answer with reasons and with examples from your own life or reading.

why.en: Answer the question directly in your introduction (agree or disagree) and keep the same view to the end. Use four paragraphs; band 5 essays often lack them.
why.uz: Kirishda savolga toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri javob bering (qoʻshilasizmi yoki yoʻqmi) va shu fikrni oxirigacha saqlang. Toʻrt xatboshi yozing: 5-ball insholarda ular koʻpincha yoʻq.
why.ru: Во введении прямо ответьте на вопрос (согласны или нет) и держите эту позицию до конца. Пишите четыре абзаца: в эссе на 5 баллов их часто нет.

stem.en:
Some students prefer to study alone, while others prefer to study with friends in a group.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Support your answer with reasons and with examples from your own life or reading.

why.en: This task has three parts: view one, view two and your opinion. Give each view its own paragraph, then state your opinion clearly.
why.uz: Bu topshiriq uch qismdan iborat: birinchi fikr, ikkinchi fikr va sizning fikringiz. Har bir fikrga alohida xatboshi bering, soʻng oʻz fikringizni aniq ayting.
why.ru: В задании три части: первое мнение, второе и ваше. Дайте каждому мнению отдельный абзац, затем ясно выскажите свою позицию.

Many teenagers say that they do not get enough sleep on school nights.

What are the causes of this problem, and what can be done about it?

Support your answer with reasons and with examples from your own life or reading.

why.ru: Ответьте на оба вопроса: причины и решения. Привяжите каждое решение к названной вами причине — так эссе будет цельным.

stem.en:
Some young people want to learn a third language as well as their first language and English.

Why do they want to do this? What is the best way to learn a new language?

Support your answer with reasons and with examples from your own life or reading.

why.en: Two questions mean two body paragraphs, one for each. A short answer to both in the introduction shows the examiner that you saw both.
why.uz: Ikki savol — ikki asosiy xatboshi, har biriga bittadan. Kirishda ikkalasiga qisqa javob bersangiz, imtihon oluvchi ikkalasini ham koʻrganingizni biladi.
why.ru: Два вопроса — два основных абзаца, по одному на каждый. Короткий ответ на оба во введении покажет экзаменатору, что вы увидели оба.

stem.en:
Some people believe that every university degree should include at least one month of work experience in a real company or organisation.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Support your answer with reasons and with examples from your own life or reading.

why.en: "To what extent" lets you agree in part, but your position must stay relevant and clear. Develop each main idea with a reason and an example.
why.uz: «To what extent» qisman qoʻshilishga imkon beradi, lekin pozitsiyangiz mos va aniq boʻlishi kerak. Har bir asosiy gʻoyani sabab va misol bilan rivojlantiring.
why.ru: «To what extent» позволяет согласиться частично, но позиция должна оставаться уместной и ясной. Развивайте каждую мысль причиной и примером.

stem.en:

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Support your answer with reasons and with examples from your own life or reading.

why.en: Treat both views fairly before giving your own. Band 6 needs every part addressed, and a one-sided essay misses part of the task.

why.ru: Честно разберите оба мнения, прежде чем дать своё. Для 6 баллов нужно ответить на все части, а однобокое эссе упускает часть задания.

stem.en:
In many towns, small local shops have closed, and some people blame the growth of online shopping.

What problems does this cause, and what could be done to solve them?

Support your answer with reasons and with examples from your own life or reading.

why.en: Choose two problems and develop them rather than listing five. Give each solution a "who": the town council, shop owners or residents.
why.uz: Beshta muammoni sanab oʻtish oʻrniga ikkitasini tanlab, rivojlantiring. Har bir yechim uchun kim bajarishini ayting: shahar hokimligi, doʻkon egalari yoki aholi.
why.ru: Выберите две проблемы и раскройте их, а не перечисляйте пять. У каждого решения назовите исполнителя: городские власти, владельцы магазинов или жители.

stem.en:
It is often said that families eat together less often than they did in the past.

Why might this be happening? Is it a positive or a negative development?

Support your answer with reasons and with examples from your own life or reading.

why.en: Answer both questions. For the second, decide "positive", "negative" or "both" and keep that view in your conclusion; band 6 conclusions can be unclear.

In some countries, many highly educated young people move abroad to work.

stem.en:
Artificial intelligence tools can now write essays and solve homework problems for students.

How should schools respond to this? Will these tools make students better or worse learners in the long term?

Support your answer with reasons and with examples from your own life or reading.

why.en: Both questions need a developed answer. Avoid extreme claims: a qualified view (it depends on how the tools are used) is easier to support well.

why.ru: Оба вопроса требуют развёрнутого ответа. Избегайте крайностей: взвешенную позицию (зависит от того, как используют инструменты) легче хорошо обосновать.
